citations.long: Routine calibration of mechanical equipment is not performed according to a written program designed to assure proper performance.
Written procedures for the receipt, identification, storage, and handling of packaging and labeling materials are not followed.

citations.short: Strict control not exercised over labeling issued
citations.long: Strict control is not exercised over labeling issued for use in drug product labeling operations.

Testing and release of drug product for distribution do not include appropriate laboratory determination of satisfactory conformance to the final specifications and identity and strength of each active ingredient prior to release.
The written stability testing program is not followed.

citations.short: Testing in same container - closure system
citations.long: The written stability program does not assure testing of the drug product in the same container-closure system as that in which the drug product is marketed.

citations.short: Identification of persons involved, each significant step
citations.long: Batch production and control records do not include the identification of the persons performing, directly supervising, and checking each significant step in the operation, for each batch of drug product produced.

citations.short: Quality control unit review of records
citations.long: Drug product production and control records, are not reviewed by the quality control unit to determine compliance with all established, approved written procedures before a batch is released or distributed.
Laboratory records do not include complete records of the periodic calibration of laboratory instruments.
